answer:
I added a "Weather in Porto now" card to the top of your Porto weekend page. I haven't seen it run, so I don't know yet what it shows.

I can't look up live weather from here, so the card fetches it itself each time you open the page. It reads current temperature, feels-like, conditions and wind from Open-Meteo. The first time, Amber Notes will ask you to approve the `api.open-meteo.com` host.

The note's text is unchanged, and the previous version of the page is kept in its history.
